infos.title: Practical information
infos.sub: The essentials to know before you arrive.
infos.tax_p: €{tax} per person per night, payable at the riad. It is charged by the city of {city} and is not included in the room rate.
infos.extras_p: All extras and services you book (transfer, dinner, cooking class, excursions, hammam, extra breakfast) are paid on site in cash.
infos.address_p: {address}. The lane is pedestrian only, so your driver drops you at the nearest entrance.
infos.checkout_p: Rooms must be vacated before {checkout}. We keep your luggage free of charge if your flight or train is later.
infos.late_p: Let us know on WhatsApp: someone will be waiting for you, whatever the time.

services.title: Book your services
services.sub: Open a service to read everything and book it without leaving this page. Everything is paid on site in cash, except group excursions which are paid online.
services.legal: Your request is sent to the riad, which confirms availability and price. Everything is paid on site in cash.

transfer.intro: A driver waits for you at the airport or the train station and takes you straight to the riad. Fixed price, no haggling, no waiting.
transfer.li1: A driver waits for you with a sign bearing your name; waiting time is included even if your flight is delayed.
transfer.li2: Private air-conditioned vehicle, fixed price per vehicle whatever the amount of luggage.
transfer.surcharge: {amount} € surcharge between {a_from} and {a_to} for the airport{station_part}.
transfer.surcharge_station: , and for station departures between {s_from} and {s_to}
transfer.discount: Airport return trip: {amount} € off the departure transfer, applied automatically.
transfer.help: Choose your trip: the price appears immediately, surcharges and return discount included.
transfer.subject: Transfer request · {name}
transfer.legal: Your request is sent to the riad, which confirms the driver and the price. The transfer is paid on site in cash.

dinner.intro: Home-cooked tagine, couscous or pastilla served by candlelight in the patio, in the lounge or on the rooftop terrace.
dinner.li1: Home-cooked tagine, couscous or pastilla, prepared the same day.
dinner.li2: Served by candlelight in the patio, in the lounge or on the rooftop terrace.
dinner.li3: To be ordered the day before, or before 4 pm on the day.
dinner.li4: Vegetarian options and allergies catered for on request.
dinner.service: Served from {from} to {to}, in the patio, in the lounge or on the terrace.
dinner.help: Choose your menu, the date and the time: the total appears immediately.

cooking.intro: Make the bread, the salads and the tagine yourself with our partner, then enjoy your own meal. Transfer included.
cooking.li1: You make the bread, the salads and the tagine yourself with our partner.
cooking.li2: About 4 hours, morning or afternoon, then you enjoy your own meal.
cooking.li3: Return transfer from the riad included.
cooking.li4: To be booked at least 24 hours in advance.

excursions.price: From {min} € per person depending on the destination
excursions.intro: Agafay, Ourika, Essaouira, the Atlas mountains, Ouzoud… in a private car with driver, leaving from the riad at your own pace.
excursions.li1: Agafay desert, Ourika valley, Essaouira, Atlas mountains and Berber valleys, Ouzoud waterfalls.
excursions.li2: Private car with driver, leaving from the riad at the time you choose.
excursions.li3: Full or half day, itinerary adapted to your own pace.
excursions.li4: Quote sent within a few hours depending on the destination and the number of people.
excursions.li5: The price per person goes down as the group grows: the total appears as soon as you pick the destination and the number of people.
excursions.help: Choose the destination, the date and the number of people: the price is worked out automatically.

group.intro: Often a cheaper alternative: hot-air balloon, quad biking, Agafay desert, waterfalls, guided tours — bookable online with free cancellation.
group.li1: Often cheaper than a private excursion: you share the vehicle and the guide.
group.li2: Hot-air balloon, quad biking, Agafay desert, waterfalls, guided tours, shows.
group.li3: Booked and paid online, free cancellation up to 24 hours before.
group.outro: Excursions, Agafay desert, hot-air balloon, quad biking, waterfalls, guided tours and much more, bookable online with free cancellation.

spa.intro: Traditional hammam, black-soap scrub and argan oil massage in a selected spa, a few steps from the riad.
spa.li1: Traditional hammam with black-soap scrub and kessa glove.
spa.li3: Selected spa a few minutes' walk from the riad.
spa.li4: Booking the day before is recommended to get the time you want.
spa.li5: {count} treatments and extras to choose from, priced in dirhams with an indicative euro equivalent.
